Package dev.opencollab.paletter.item

Class BedrockItemStack.Builder

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.item.BedrockItemStack.Builder
Enclosing class:
BedrockItemStack
public static final class BedrockItemStack.Builder extends Object
Builds a BedrockItemStack. Only the variant is required; the count defaults to 1, the aux to the variant's, the lists to empty and the rest to none.
Since:
1.0.0

    • aux

      public @NonNull BedrockItemStack.Builder aux(int aux)
      Sets the aux value to send for a stack of a base variant, where it names no variant: a legacy damage value, or what a client sent. A named variant is the variant itself, e.g. BedrockItems.POTION.variant(5).
      Parameters:
      aux - the aux value
      Returns:
      this builder
      Since:
      1.0.0
